was: Private RV park (aka Savannah River RV Park), 101 Stockyard Rd, Sylvania. 25 full-hookup sites; nightly + long-term, booked via Campspot. Operator describes it as bordered by the Savannah River. RV Life 5★/$, 1 review; confirmed operating via active Campspot booking page. --Claude
note: Small private RV park in Sylvania, about 30 minutes from Statesboro and an hour from Augusta and Savannah, also listed as Savannah River RV Park; it takes nightly, weekly and long-term stays. --Claude

note: Private RV park and outdoor center on Big Cedar Creek at Cave Spring, with 62 full-hookup RV sites plus tent and group sites, and canoe, kayak and tube rentals with a shuttle; the creekside sites have more tree cover. --Claude

was: Small (10-site, more planned) full-hookup park at 12319 N Central St, Bristol; 30/50-amp, sewer, level rocked pads, $40-60/night. Takes short-term and extended stays (big-rig friendly). Reservable online via Campspot. Described as across from the Apalachicola River.

was: Private RV park at 10885 N Suncoast Blvd (US-19/98), Inglis, ~12 min N of Crystal River between the Withlacoochee River and the Cross Florida Barge Canal, ~10 min to the Gulf. Nightly/transient from ~$68 (Passport America half-price), reservable online via Campspot; full hookups (20/30/50-amp), oversized lots, pull-throughs, two bathhouses w/ laundry, pool.

was: Gated owner-occupied RV resort at 2359 US Hwy 17, Crescent City. 80+ big-rig sites, full hookups (30 & 50 amp), free cable/WiFi, pull-throughs; heated pool, pickleball, dog park, clubhouse, laundry, propane. Child/pet-friendly (lodge cabins adults-only). Reservable nightly online via Campspot.

was: Riverside resort on the St. Johns River in Welaka with 23 RV-only big-rig sites, full hookups (20/30/50 amp). Pool, on-site restaurant/bar, boat ramp, fishing dock, boat/kayak rentals. Nightly/weekly/monthly; reservable online via Campspot.
